verdict.rationale: Notte documents a hosted, Bearer-authenticated HTTP API with an agent-start endpoint that runs web AI agents on cloud browser sessions it manages, so the agent never runs a browser itself. The evidence never shows how results come back: there is no status or polling endpoint and no registrable webhook callback. missing for 10: documented polling/status retrieval for agent runs, registrable outbound webhooks for task completion, independent hands-on corroboration of the API task flow.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself

citations.quote: used to create cloud browser sessions, scrape webpages, and run web ai agents to act on your behalf on the internet
All API requests require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
Give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites
Sessions are isolated browser instances running in the cloud that you can control programmatically.
